parsed.explanation: No trans-specific criminal offence, universal facility/custody rule, or documented police/border targeting is shown, and same-sex conduct is not criminalised. Against that, the latest sourced climate evidence (2018) reports hostility toward visibly gender-nonconforming people, especially in the capital; harassment in post-2010 displacement camps is dated and unquantified; a 2019 advocate's death is unresolved and unconfirmed as poisoning, so it proves no pattern. No visitor-facing remedy is documented and the judiciary is described as not functioning as protection, while resident-facing gaps alone are not deducted. On thin, dated data the documented hostility with no working recourse, extrapolated from that structure, places this in elevated risk, below jurisdictions with acceptance and operating remedies.
